justification: Descriptions with usable describes links to o-trip (system, now): a-trip (dl-trip) and a-trip-2 (dl-trip-2). prohibited: any second causal step under the cause a-spark, in particular a-dust (cc-dust) presented as what caused a-spark inside explain's answer, or any chained derivation e-jam <- a-spark <- a-dust: explain is one step back and no causal chain reader exists (GAP-CAUSE-1); also an execution error, timeout or unestablished refusal
justification: explain lists the judged state, its accepted initiating events and their causal claims, one step back only (explain 2, 9: GAP-CAUSE-1; causes_of 3: nothing chained). The fixture does contain cc-dust (a-dust causes a-spark), so a reader that chained would have data to fabricate a two-step chain from. causes_of entries have no nested causes field, so the only safe outcome at this path is absence.

prohibited: any list of what o-leak caused (for example o-flood from cc-leak presented as a forward-reader answer), or any derived forward causal conclusion: no forward reader exists (causes_of is keyed on the effect only)
justification: causes_of 1: the reader is keyed on the effect only; there is no forward reader (GAP-CAUSE-2). The plan is empty: no reader can be asked, so the probe is not callable and the only safe outcome is that nothing is produced.

prohibited: any definite answer that press-4 would or would not be jammed at T8 had e-jam not happened (for example 'not jammed' by deleting ce-jam's effect, or 'still jammed' from att-jam): no intervention operator exists; the state does not depend on the effect claim (effects_of 3)
justification: GAP-CAUSE-3: no counterfactual intervention operator. The plan is empty (not callable). The approved hypothetical override only stipulates that an occurrence did not happen (causes_of 4, occurrence_status 4); it propagates nothing to states, and claims never make a change (effects_of 3), so any answer about the jammed state under intervention would be fabricated.

prohibited: any strength, probability, mechanism type or enabling/preventing label on the o-leak entry: cc-leak records none and the model has no such field (GAP-CAUSE-5)
justification: causes_of 2 fixes the entry fields (cause, effect, level, lifted, lifted_via, occurrences, applies, judgement, status, claimed_by, attestations); strength is not among them, and GAP-CAUSE-5 records that no causal strength, probability or mechanism exists. The fixture's claim_cause carries none.

prohibited: an attribution value on the effects_of entry; in particular 'unique', which would contradict the approved semantics (ce-unlock fits two beginnings of gate-3, T4 and T9, so it is ambiguous, SD-CAU-1 and changes 3) and would present unique causation from an accepted claim on an ambiguous transition
justification: SD-CAU-1 approves attribution on effects_of entries but marks it G-unimpl (0.11; gaps.md table): a scored question must not expect it and a probe accepts absent. For reference, the approved value would be 'ambiguous' (one initiates claim that fits two activations on the whole timeline). A coordinator may choose to treat a present 'ambiguous' as non-fabricated; I accept only absent, as gaps.md prescribes.

prohibited: a timing value for e-tremor, in particular 'consistent' (its start window [T8, T10] contains t = T9, so the approved value would be 'unresolved'), or exclusion of e-tremor from initiated_by (it does not certainly start after t)
justification: SD-CAU-2: an uncertain time keeps the event with timing unresolved; timing on explain is G-unimpl (0.11; gaps.md). Only absence is safe. e-tremor itself must remain listed (see C-018).

prohibited: e-kick (the contractor's unaccepted ce-kick) presented as an explanation in initiated_by, or any top-level alternatives list fabricated in place of the unimplemented field
justification: SD-CAU-2: unaccepted initiating claims belong in alternatives, never explanations; top-level alternatives on explain is G-unimpl (0.11; gaps.md). Here the unaccepted claim is ce-kick (e-kick, contractor, not accepted by the system). The safe outcome is the absent field; the explanation list must stay [e-jam] (see C-017). The holds answer's own holds.alternatives is a different, implemented field.

prohibited: an attestations list on the explanation entry, and in particular any presentation of ce-fill as evidence of the change (an asserted effect is not evidence of the change, changes 6)
justification: SD-CAU-4 approves an attestations list on each changes explanation claim, marked G-unimpl (0.11; gaps.md). The explanation itself (ce-fill for e-fill, see C-022) is implemented; only its attestations field is probed.

justification: SD-CAU-9: effect claims carry each occurrence's status and applies, G-unimpl for effects_of (0.11; gaps.md). Only absence is safe.
ill_posed: The question's parenthesis presupposes 'the occurrence it is about', but e-jam is an account with no occurrence parameter and no describe_occurrence step, so it describes no known occurrence (v0.2 3.2 default). The probe still works as an absence check, but its wording rests on a false premise.
